messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH ERROR RATE — GPU OOMs observed during prefill on pool rdx-dedicated-usw-1. Model=r13b-2q, affected nodes=node-xy-12,node-xy-13. 15 container restarts in 7m. @sam_oncall paged.
sam_oncall: I'm on it. beginning triage — grabbing logs and metrics.
mike_infra: I'm sshing into node-xy-12 now, will check dmesg and driver state.
julia_sre: Any customer-facing impact yet?
sam_oncall: Early telemetry: +6-9% 5xx on /v1/stream in us-west for the last 10m. Circuit fallback to smaller variants triggered for a subset.
lena_support: CS: two enterprise customers reported elevated error rates and reconnect storms, ticket INC-7892 opened.
sam_oncall: kubectl logs from pod inference-pod-xy-12 (excerpt):
```
[2026-03-17T15:02:11Z] runtime: CUDA error: out of memory while allocating 2147483648 bytes
[2026-03-17T15:02:12Z] prefill: requested_sequence_len=65536 kv_cache_reserve=high
[2026-03-17T15:02:12Z] signal: container restarting (OOM)
```
mike_infra: dmesg shows GPU driver reset around the same time; possible memory fragmentation + large prefill window.
julia_sre: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) reduce max_prefill_tokens for this pool 2) enable aggressive eviction for prefix cache 3) roll traffic to fallback model variant r13b-2q-small.
sam_oncall: Applying config change to configmap prefill-config in inference namespace. Patch:
```
kubectl patch configmap prefill-config -n inference --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/max_prefill_tokens","value":8192}]'
```
Will roll to 50% of pods first.
ops-bot: patch accepted, rollout started (80 pods targeted).
sam_oncall: Scaling concurrency on pool rdx-dedicated-usw-1 -> concurrency=1 for affected nodes to reduce simultaneous prefill pressure.
mike_infra: Draining node-xy-12 to run memory/driver diagnostics, cordon + evicting pods.
julia_sre: Noted that long-sequence requests (65k tokens) bypassed our prefill cap due to earlier config drift. Need audit on config sync.
lena_support: Notified customers and provided ETA: mitigations in progress, expect error rate to normalize in ~10-20m. CS handed off to account reps.
sam_oncall: Observing immediate drop in restarts after patch + concurrency change. Error spikes down to ~1-2% in us-west. Keeping watch.
julia_sre: Handoff to night oncall: @julia_sre will own monitoring and follow-up; please escalate if restarts resume. Actions to follow-up in PM: node inspection results, config drift RCA, add guardrail to reject >16k prefill at gateway.
sam_oncall: Summary for handoff -> cause: large prefill requests + kv-cache fragmentation -> driver resets/OOM -> container restarts. Mitigations applied: max_prefill_tokens=8192, eviction aggressive, concurrency=1, drained node-xy-12 for inspection, traffic partly routed to smaller model variant. Customer impact: two enterprise tickets, transient increase in 5xx.
julia_sre: Acknowledged, will keep monitoring metrics and logs overnight. I created postmortem ticket INC-7892-PM and added owners.
ops-bot: Incident severity reduced to SEV-2. Continue monitoring for 3h.
sam_oncall: Leaving runbook notes in thread and pushing logs to S3: s3://redwood-incident-logs/3009000001/
lena_support: Updated CS with mitigation summary and postmortem ETA.
incident-bot: Reminder — please attach any kernel logs/driver dumps to the PM ticket.
julia_sre: Will attach dmesg and nvdec logs after node inspection.
sam_oncall: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
